title: Compile shared Gaussian records while paying every read in precision
statement: For an acquired joint record within epsilon_in of N(m,C tensor I),known child programs Q_i with uniform standalone epsilon_i law and exact query-preserving gauges,and fixed affine read matrix A,a positive correlated-seed compiler retains old means at covariance C_new=(C^-1-A^T Gamma A-J)^-1 when its precision is positive. Full joint TV is at most epsilon_in+sum epsilon_i;each child runs once and old source subtrees are not rerun merely to serve a read.

requires: Complete JOINT old-record law,not approximate Gaussian marginals
Known fixed scales/gauges,query-preserving physical points and every-execution caps
Metadata independent of observed record error/values;uniform conditioning on an independent outer anchor allowed
provides: Explicit D/P seed construction yields jointly independent standard effective seeds at the ideal input
DAG final precision D_noise^-1-A^T Gamma A,with all positive-slack costs tracked
Computed response constructs an actual query-free reserve;under stated child orthogonality the within-DAG fraction rho is preserved
Unused-slot repair restores promotion orthogonality with paid reserve/gauge loss;W2 contracts use their separate stated hypotheses
assumptions: Cannot retain the old variance unchanged after a nonzero read in this lift
Post-reserve W2 is not a pre-reserve contract
Finished internal response need not be orthogonal to the external-center gauge
costs: Each standalone child and coefficient-acquisition cost paid once per node
M Gaussian vector slots;safe scalar preprocessing O(M^3+m^3),vector work O(dM^2+dkm),storage O(M^2+m^2) plus child costs
After H generic promotions,rho can fall to rho_initial/2^H and direct gauge factor grows as2^(H/2);full recurrence also pays1/sqrt(rho)
Final affine output variance w^TCw must fit target before adding noise
contract.units: Joint full-law TV,known scalar precision matrices and original query caps
contract.obstruction: Conditional acquired reuse compiler,not the missing nonlinear child,polylog total recursion or device advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Full joint Gaussian-record absorption,precision/reserve/gauge closure and costs under supplied actual-program metadata.

evidence.quote: Decision: accept the listed mathematical/program interfaces
evidence.range_scope: Completed unblinded source-read curator reconstruction of these exact proofs;ideal-real mathematical scope only,no scientific code execution or unseen earlier audit transfer.

body: Gaussian effective seeds establish the complete law even for nonlinear/non-Gaussian standalone children. Data-selected metadata needs a new proof.
